capabilities: Compress selected attachments from the file explorer via right-click
Compress all attachments embedded in the current note or the open file with commands
Replace originals in place while keeping links working, renaming when the real format differs from the extension
Choose compression level (lossless, recommended, extreme) and a maximum image width
Optionally keep the original and write a -min copy instead
extras: Files are uploaded over HTTPS to micompress.com and compressed there, so an internet connection is required; originals are deleted within about 10 minutes and results within 24 hours per the service's privacy policy. Anonymous use has per-type size limits (e.g. 20 MB for images); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Large screenshots and scanned PDFs make vaults grow to gigabytes and sync slowly, and Obsidian has no built-in way to shrink those attachments.
summary: Attachment compressor that shrinks images, PDFs, audio, video and Office files in place via the micompress.com web service.
